title: Dua for Acceptance
arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas Samee'ul Aleem
translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) recited after building the Kaaba with his son. Recite this whenever you want Allah (swt) to accept your good deeds — after prayer, charity, or any act of worship.

title: Dua to affirm faith and pray for the Muslim Ummah
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana waj'alnaa muslimaini laka wa min zurriyyatinaaa ummatam muslimatal laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub 'alainaa innaka antat Tawwaabur Raheem
translation: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) recited after building the Kaaba. Recite to affirm your faith in Islam and to pray for the success and guidance of the entire Muslim Ummah and future generations.

title: Dua for Good in Both Worlds
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid dunyaa hasanatanw wa fil aakhirati hasanatanw wa qinaa azaaban Naar
translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
description: One of the most beloved duas any believer can recite. It balances asking for goodness in this life while never forgetting the hereafter. Recite it daily, especially after salah.

title: Dua for Patience and Victory
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alainaa sabranw wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
description: Prophetic dua of Prophet Dawud (as) before facing Jalut (Goliath). Recite when facing hardship, seeking patience, or standing firm against oppression and injustice.

title: Dua for Forgiveness of Errors
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
transliteration: Rabbana laa tu'aakhiznaaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa
translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.
description: A dua for tawbah (repentance). Asking Allah's forgiveness for unintentional sins, mistakes, and moments of forgetfulness. A reminder of our complete reliance on Allah's mercy.

title: Dua for Ease in Hardship
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
transliteration: Rabbana wa laa tahmil-'alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa
translation: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.
description: Asking Allah to make the path of righteousness easy and not to test us beyond our capacity. Recite when feeling overwhelmed by the burdens of life.

title: Dua for Pardon and Mercy
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
description: From the last ayat of Surah Al-Baqarah — among the most memorized verses of the Quran. The Prophet (ﷺ) said reciting the last two verses of Baqarah at night is sufficient protection.

title: Dua for a Steadfast Heart
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaitanaa wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah; innaka antal Wahhaab
translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
description: A beautiful dua asking Allah to keep our hearts firm on guidance and not let worldly distractions or circumstances cause them to swerve. Recite frequently to protect your iman.

title: Dua Affirming the Day of Judgement
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami'unnasi li-Yawmil la raiba fi innallaha la yukhliful mi'aad
translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
description: A dua affirming faith in the Hereafter and the certainty of the Day of Judgement. Recite to strengthen your conviction in Allah's promise.

title: Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Hellfire
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa qinaa 'azaaban Naar
translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
description: A declaration of faith followed by a plea for forgiveness and protection from Jahannam. Recite as a daily reminder of your belief and reliance on Allah's mercy.

title: Dua of Faith and Testimony
arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth].
description: A dua of faith and worship — asking to be recorded among those who witness and testify to the truth. Recite to affirm your belief in the message of the Prophets.

title: Dua for Repentance and Victory
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lanaa zunoobanaa wa israafanaa feee amirnaa wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
description: A dua for repentance, victory, and resiliency — to stand firm in the face of evil. The verse that follows promises: Allah loves the doers of good.

title: Dua of Gratitude and Protection
arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haaza baatilalan Subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban Naar
translation: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
description: A dua of reflection and gratitude — recognizing that nothing in creation is without purpose. Recite when contemplating the beauty and design of Allah's world.

title: Dua on the Reality of Hellfire
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka man tudkhilin Naara faqad akhzai tahoo wa maa lizzaalimeena min ansaar
translation: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire – You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
description: A dua reminding us of the fate of the wrongdoers. Recite as motivation to account for your deeds and steer away from sin — knowing there are no helpers for the unjust.

title: Dua of Submission to Faith
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyai yunaadee lil eemaani an aaminoo bi Rabbikum fa aamannaa
translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller, calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed.
description: A dua of humility, submission, and faith — declaring that we heard the call of the Prophet (ﷺ) and we believed. Recite to renew and reaffirm your iman.

title: Dua to Die Among the Righteous
arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa saiyi aatina wa tawaffanaa ma'al abraar
translation: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.
description: A dua for repentance and a good ending — asking Allah to wipe away our sins and let us die as righteous believers. One of the last ten verses of Surah Aal-Imran.

title: Dua for Allah's Promise on the Day of Resurrection
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'attanaa 'alaa Rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa Yawmal Qiyaamah; innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad
translation: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
description: A dua of humility asking Allah to fulfil His promise to the believers and to not disgrace us on the Day of Judgement. Recite to reaffirm complete trust in Allah's word.

title: Dua to Be Counted Among the Witnesses
arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
description: A brief but powerful dua for those who want to testify to the truth and affirm their belief. Recite to ask Allah to count you among the sincere and grateful believers.

title: Dua for Provision
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa anzil 'alainaa maaa'idatam minas samaaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eedal li awwalinaa wa aakhirinaa wa Aayatam minka warzuqnaa wa Anta khairur raaziqeen
translation: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.
description: Dua of Prophet Isa (AS) asking for provision and sustenance. Recite when seeking rizq in all its forms — wealth, health, food, and the blessings of this life.

title: Dua of Adam — Seeking Forgiveness
arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
description: The dua of Prophet Adam (AS) after sinning in paradise. A profound expression of humility and repentance. Recite when you have erred and seek Allah's forgiveness with a sincere heart.

title: Dua to Be Kept from the Wrongdoers
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al qawmiz zaalimeen
translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.
description: A dua for protection from the company of the unjust. We are shaped by those we surround ourselves with — this dua asks Allah to shield us from being counted among the wrongdoers.

title: Dua for Justice — Allah is the Best Judge
arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaf-tah bainana wa baina qawmina bil haqqi wa anta Khairul Fatiheen
translation: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.
description: Dua of Prophet Shuaib (AS) after facing persecution for his faith. Recite when facing injustice or conflict — entrusting the outcome entirely to Allah, the best of judges.

title: Dua for Patience and a Muslim Death
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh 'alainaa sabranw wa tawaffanaa muslimeen
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
description: Dua of Prophet Musa (AS) for sabr and a righteous end. Recite when faced with trials and to ask Allah to keep you steadfast in faith until your last breath.

title: Dua for Protection from Oppression
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatal lil-qawmidh-Dhalimeen wa najjina bi-Rahmatika minal qawmil kafireen
translation: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
description: Dua of the companions of Prophet Musa (AS) facing the tyrannical Firawn. Recite when in situations of oppression or persecution — asking Allah for mercy and deliverance.

title: Dua Affirming Allah's Complete Knowledge
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'lin; wa maa yakhfaa 'alal laahi min shai'in fil ardi wa laa fis samaaa'
translation: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.
description: A dua showing complete trust and reliance on Allah — acknowledging that He knows what is in our hearts, our intentions, and everything we conceal or reveal.

title: Dua to Establish Prayer for Generations
arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbij 'alnee muqeemas Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aaa
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) asking Allah to keep him and his descendants steadfast in prayer. Recite for yourself and your children — that salah be established in your family.

title: Dua for Forgiveness of Parents
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) asking for forgiveness for himself, his parents, and all believers on the Day of Reckoning. One of the best gifts a child can give their parents.

title: Dua of the People of the Cave
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatanw wa haiyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
description: Dua of the young men of the cave (Ashab al-Kahf) who fled persecution for their faith. Recite when seeking guidance, mercy, and clarity in difficult or uncertain times.

title: Dua of Musa and Harun For Courage and Protection
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَى
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa
translation: Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.
description: Dua of Prophets Musa (AS) and Harun (AS) before confronting the tyrant Firawn. Allah responded: 'Do not be afraid. I am surely with you both — I hear and I see.' Recite when courage is needed.

title: Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy
arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.
description: A dua calling upon Allah by His attribute of Ar-Rahim — the Most Merciful. Affirm your faith and ask for His mercy, for He is the best of those who show mercy.

title: Dua for Protection from Hellfire
arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba Jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.
description: A sobering dua asking Allah to protect us from the eternal punishment of Jahannam. Recite as a reminder of the reality of the Hereafter and to stay firm on the right path.

title: Dua for Righteous Family
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
description: A dua for joy, comfort, and blessings through family. Asking Allah to bless our spouses and children to be a source of peace and to make us leaders for the righteous.

title: Praise of Allah — Al-Ghafoor, Ash-Shakur
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
transliteration: Rabbana la Ghafurun shakur
translation: Our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative.
description: A short but profound dua of praise — the Quran tells us the believers will recite this in paradise. Allah forgives us despite our shortcomings and appreciates even our smallest good deeds.

title: Dua Calling on Allah's Infinite Mercy
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmatanw wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azaabal Jaheem
translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
description: A dua proclaiming that Allah's mercy and knowledge are limitless. Asking Him to forgive all those who have repented and followed His way — a dua of the angels for the believers.

title: Dua for Entry into Jannah with Family
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذَلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana wa adhkhilhum Jannati 'adninil-lati wa'attahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa dhuriyyatihim innaka antal 'Azizul-Hakim waqihimus saiyi'at wa man taqis-saiyi'ati yawma'idhin faqad rahimatahu wa dhalika huwal fawzul-'Adheem
translation: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day – You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment.
description: A dua asking for the believers and their families to be reunited in Jannah. The angels make this dua for the believers — a beautiful supplication for family, protection, and the highest reward.

title: Dua for Unity of the Ummah
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lanaa wa li ikhwaani nal lazeena sabqoonaa bil eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillalil lazeena aamanoo
translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed.
description: A dua for unity — asking Allah to purify our hearts of resentment towards our fellow believers. We are one Ummah; this dua reminds us to love for others what we love for ourselves.

title: Praise of Allah — Ar-Ra'uf, Ar-Raheem
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Rabbannaaa innaka Ra'oofur Raheem
translation: Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
description: A short dua of praise calling upon Allah by two of His beautiful names — Ar-Ra'uf (the Benign, the Compassionate) and Ar-Raheem (the Most Merciful). Recite to connect with Allah's infinite kindness.

title: Dua of Complete Reliance on Allah
arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa 'alaika tawakkalnaa wa ilaika anabnaa wa ilaikal maseer
translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
description: A dua of complete tawakkul — declaring that our trust, our return, and our final destination are all with Allah alone. A powerful reminder that this life is temporary.

title: Dua for Protection from Being a Trial
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaaa innaka antal azeezul hakeem
translation: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) asking Allah to keep the believers victorious and not make them objects of trial for those who disbelieve. Recite when facing opposition for your deen.

title: Dua to Perfect Our Light
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
description: A dua asking Allah to perfect the light of the believers on the Day of Judgement — when the righteous will walk with a light from their right hands. Recite as a dua for a luminous end.

title: Dua for Guidance — Al-Fatihah
arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
transliteration: Ihdinas siraatal mustaqeem
translation: Guide us to the Straight Way.
description: The most recited dua in Islam — said at minimum 17 times a day in salah. Asking Allah to show us a clear, easy, and straight path that leads to Him and to paradise. The most beneficial dua a believer can make.

title: Dua of Prophet Nuh — Seeking Refuge from Ignorance
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihi 'ilm wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamnee akum minal khaasireen
translation: O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have Mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.
description: Dua of Prophet Nuh (as) after asking Allah for something he had no knowledge of. A reminder to ask only for what is good, and to seek forgiveness when we overstep. Recite to guard against asking for things that may harm us.

title: Dua of Prophet Yusuf — Dying as a Muslim
arabic: فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Faatiras samaawaati wal ardi Anta waliyyee fid dunyaa wal aakhirah tawaffanee muslimaw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen
translation: Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Protector in this world and in the Hereafter, cause me to die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
description: Dua of Prophet Yusuf (as) after Allah made his dream come true. After a life of tests and hardship, he asked only to die as a Muslim and to be joined with the righteous. Recite as a prayer for a blessed and faithful ending.

title: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim — For Peace and Protection from Shirk
arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
transliteration: Rabbij 'al haazal balada aaminanw wajnubnee wa baniyya an na'budal asnaam
translation: O my Lord! Make this city one of peace and security, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (as) — asking for peace in the land and protection from idol worship. Recite to seek safety in your home and community, and to guard yourself and your family from attachment to anything other than Allah.

title: Dua for Parents
arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbir hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa
translation: My Lord! Bestow on them Your Mercy as they did bring me up when I was small.
description: The most well-known dua for parents in the Quran. Asking Allah to shower His mercy on those who raised us. Recite daily for your parents, grandparents, and all those who nurtured you when you were young.

title: Dua for a Truthful Entry and Exit
arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqinw wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqinw waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
translation: My Lord! Let my entry be good, and likewise my exit be good. And grant me from You an authority to help me.
description: A prophetic dua for every beginning and ending — entering a job, a month, a journey, a new phase of life. Asking Allah to make every entry and exit sincere, blessed, and guided by clear authority from Him.

title: Dua of Prophet Musa — For an Open Heart and Clear Speech
arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbish rah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wahlul 'uqdatam mil lisaanee yafqahoo qawlee
translation: O my Lord! Open for me my chest, and ease my task for me, and make loose the knot from my tongue, that they understand my speech.
description: Dua of Prophet Musa (as) before confronting Firawn — asking for an open heart, ease in affairs, and clarity of speech. Recite before giving a speech, teaching, having a difficult conversation, or starting any challenging task.

title: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim — For Wisdom, Legacy and Jannah
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen waj'alnee min warasati jannatun na'eem
translation: My Lord! Bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous; and grant me an honourable mention in later generations; and make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.
description: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (as) asking for four gifts: wisdom, company of the righteous, a truthful legacy after death, and entry into Jannah. Recite as a comprehensive dua for both this life and the next.

title: Dua of Prophet Sulaiman — Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas saaliheen
translation: My Lord! Inspire me that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves.
description: Dua of Prophet Sulaiman (as) upon hearing the speech of an ant. A dua of deep gratitude — asking Allah to inspire thankfulness for His blessings on us and our parents, and to be admitted by His mercy into paradise.

title: Dua of Prophet Yunus — From the Belly of the Whale
arabic: لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but You, Glorified are You. Truly, I have been of the wrongdoers.
description: Dua of Prophet Yunus (as) from inside the whale — in complete darkness, utterly alone. Three things: affirming Tawheed, glorifying Allah, and admitting fault. The Prophet ﷺ said any Muslim who makes this dua sincerely will be answered by Allah.

title: Dua of Prophet Zakariya — For a Righteous Child
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi laa tazarnee fardan wa Anta khairul waariseen
translation: O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors.
description: Dua of Prophet Zakariya (as) — in old age, fearing he would be left without an heir for his da'wah. Allah answered and blessed him with Yahya (as). Recite when longing for a child, a companion, or simply not wanting to be alone in life.

title: Dua of Prophet Nuh — For a Blessed Landing
arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen
translation: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land.
description: Dua of Prophet Nuh (as) as the ark came to rest after the great flood. Asking Allah for a blessed and safe place to settle. Recite when moving homes, traveling, starting in a new place, or returning after a long absence.

title: Dua for Protection from Shaytan
arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish shayaateeni wa a'oodhu bika Rabbi ay yahduroon
translation: My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the devils. And I seek refuge with You, My Lord, lest they may attend (come near) me.
description: A prophetic dua for seeking refuge from the whisperings and presence of the shayateen. Recite when feeling the pull of bad thoughts, distractions during worship, or when shaytan attempts to lead you astray.

title: Dua of Prophet Ayyub — In Times of Hardship and Illness
arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Annee massaniyad durru wa Anta arhamur raahimeen
translation: Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
description: Dua of Prophet Ayyub (as) after years of illness and loss — he lost his health, his wealth, and his children. He did not complain in detail; he simply expressed his state and relied on Allah's mercy. Allah responded and doubled all he had lost.

title: Dua of Prophet Musa — For Any Good from Allah
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me.
description: Dua of Prophet Musa (as) after helping two women at a well — tired, alone, and in need. He expressed his state to Allah without specifying what he needed, leaving it to Allah's wisdom. A lesson in complete reliance. Allah immediately answered with provision and a wife.

title: Dua for Increase in Knowledge
arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
translation: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
description: The shortest and one of the most powerful duas in the Quran — a divine command to the Prophet ﷺ himself. Ask Allah to increase you in beneficial knowledge at any time, especially before studying, reading Quran, or seeking to understand the deen.

title: Dua of Sufficiency — Allah is Enough
arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem
translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped but He. In Him I put my trust and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
description: A dua of absolute sufficiency and tawakkul. Allah commanded the Prophet ﷺ to say this when people turned away from guidance. A declaration that Allah alone is enough — in times of rejection, difficulty, or uncertainty.
